sources.subset_growth: Paper section 6.4: add 1000 documents until no additional labels; release dynamic_GMM.py only accepts a fixed prefix
sources.topic_count: Paper section 5.1 permits BERTopic estimation; notebooks/bertopic.ipynb uses MiniLM, UMAP(5,5), HDBSCAN(min_cluster_size=20). example.ipynb instead uses 10; 20 is the explicit default here, overridable
sources.improvement_defaults: OpenWordMLTC/self_training/self_training.py argparse defaults and deletion rule; no complete per-dataset tuning mapping is published
sources.paper_rule: Paper sections 5.3 and 6.4: frequency >15, frequency <1%, median maximum similarity threshold. Exact frequency population, ordering and addition cap are operational choices recorded in iteration logs
sources.classifiers: OpenWordMLTC/zero-shot/zero-shot_AAPD_test.py main: BART, XLM-R, DeBERTa; improvement separately defaults to DeBERTa
